title: Demise
description: A recreation of Hermitcraft Season 10's Demise game
body:
A near-perfect recreation of the Demise game from Hermitcraft Season 10.

This datapack was made for a video on my channel. I can't gurantee it's very thoroughly bugtested, but it should work fine.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/8zY7ZiZNztA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


I am in no way affiliated with Hermitcraft or any of its members, and I sincerely hope I'm actually allowed to do this becuase that would be very awkward, but if I'm not, you can message me on Twitter or something I guess.
